subject: Plot to compare the physical and genetic position of markers?

messages.author: f1bd412b8986e183
messages.subject: Plot to compare the physical and genetic position of markers?
parts:
Hi all,

Currently I am using R/QTL for QTL analysis and genetic map construction with a tomato RIL-population.

I was wondering, is it possible to plot a figure with both the physical and genetic map? So a plot to visually compare the genetic positions and physical positions of the markers on each chromosome?

Thanks!

Jsaper

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Plot to compare the physical and genetic position of markers?
parts:
You can plot two maps side by side:

plot(gmap, pmap)

karl
